title: I Think, I Question, Therefore I Am
seoTitle: I Think, I Question, Therefore I Am | Faraz Ansari
description: A deeply personal essay questioning consciousness, identity, memory, time, loss, faith and what it means to be truly alive.
deck: But who is this 'I' that thinks? And why am I conscious of being alive at all?
keywords: what does it mean to be alive
